members.name: DisplayInDebugConsole
members.signature: Public Sub DisplayInDebugConsole(Optional FilePath As String)
members.description: `FilePath` is optional, if omitted will display a file dialog for choosing the file

members.name: Count
members.description: Returns the count of properties defined in the collection

members.name: FilePath
members.description: Returns a string containing the full file path of the file that was opened

members.name: Item
members.signature: Property Get Item(ByVal IndexOrNameOrID As Variant) As FileProperty
members.description: IndexOrNameOrID can be an integer index (from zero to .Count-1) or can be a name that corresponds to FileProperty.Name or can be an ID that corresponds to FileProperty.ID

members.name: ID
members.description: This is a unique identity that can always be used to refer to the property. It consists of a GUID (identifying the property schema) followed by an integer (identifying the property index in the schema).

members.name: Name
members.description: Returns the system identity name of the property. e.g. 'System.ItemFolderNameDisplay'. This is safe to use as an identity field even on non-English systems.

members.name: NameDesc
members.description: This is a localized version of the name, but is not always available

members.name: Value
members.description: This is a VARIANT value respresenting the current value of the property. TIP: This can be an array for multi-value type properties

members.name: Value
members.signature: Property Let Value(ByVal Value As Variant)
members.description: This is the write method for the property Value. Requires Vista or newer. Returns a 'Permission Denied' error if the property is not writable

members.name: ValueDesc
members.description: This is a STRING value representing the current value of the property, in LOCALIZED form. Multi-value properties are already combined into a single string

members.name: BrowseAndOpenFile
members.signature: Function BrowseAndOpenFile(Optional ByVal WriteSupport As Boolean) As FileProperties
members.description: Opens a file dialog for the user to select a file, and then returns a FileProperties collection that contains details of the properties available on the file
